notes.ema: TA-Lib EMA. Seed is an SMA, then alpha = 2/(period+1).
notes.rsi: TA-Lib RSI. Wilder smoothing. This seeded series has no fully flat window. The library returns NaN there, which TA-Lib calls 0. That case is not in this fixture.
notes.atr: TA-Lib ATR. Wilder smoothing of true range. Warmup is the period.
notes.bollinger: TA-Lib BBANDS with matype SMA. Population stddev, ddof 0.
notes.macd: TA-Lib EMA(fast) minus TA-Lib EMA(slow), then TA-Lib EMA of that line. TA-Lib MACD() re-seeds the faster EMA and is not this series.
notes.stochastic: Fast %K from TA-Lib MIN and MAX, no extra smoothing. %D is an SMA. Overlapping bars were checked against TA-Lib STOCHF. This seeded series has no zero range. The library returns NaN there, which TA-Lib calls 0. That case is not in this fixture.
